findings.finding: The QUO-02 fix is only half done. The note now shows the see going on (Zabdas, Hermon, 'the apostolic chair, which has been preserved there until the present time'), then ends: 'The see carried on, but that the new pilgrim church was the same community is only an inference.' It never says why. Read alone, it states continuity and then denies it. The link now carries the same kind of evidence that makes Aksum Documented (a bishop named before and after, plus Eusebius saying outright that the chair went on). Without the reason QUO-02 itself named (the earlier movement is the church of the whole province, not the Jerusalem see alone), the Thin grade looks inconsistent with the Aksum link.
findings.evidence: cic/texts/npnf201_eusebius-church-history-life-of-constantine.xml:43152-43154 'succeeded to the apostolic chair, which has been preserved there until the present time.'; 64939 'the Bishop Macarius.'; Findings_Record QUO-02: 'The real difference from Aksum is that the Palestinian movement has no continuesAs and centres on Caesarea and Origen ... have the note give the true reason.' Census palestinian-church-pre-constantinian relationsSummary: 'This is the province where Origen taught'.
findings.required_fix: note: "In the library at Aelia, as Jerusalem was then called, Eusebius saw letters that Bishop Alexander had gathered. He names the next bishops of the city down to Hermon. He says their chair was kept there until his own time. Later, Constantine wrote to Macarius, its bishop, about building the Church of the Savior. So the see of Jerusalem carried on. But the earlier church was the church of the whole province, not of Jerusalem alone. To call the later pilgrim church the same community is only an inference." (FRE 62.8, FK 7.7; longest sentence 18 words.)

findings.finding: STR-04 is logged for the census owner, but this pass can fix it without changing any method rule or settled ruling. The Old Believers' relationsSummary states as fact that they 'grew out of Muscovite Christianity'. No link carries that claim: the era-6 link is 'influenced' at Inferential-Thin, and the era-7 link is 'influenced' (the Stoglav's two-finger rule). Era 8 drafted the missing 'gave rise to' link, and its round-1 review passed it (R1-15, a wording fix). It was dropped only because of an id collision, and era 8 handed it to P2-L11 (Open-Gaps 94, 'Era 7 and era 8 typed three links differently', 2026-11-08). The finding itself says both claims are separately true and separately evidenced, and two links on one pair are allowed under the Drafting Brief. That is a remedy in hand, not a movement text that is wrong beyond a sentence. Logging it again leaves a descent claim standing as fact with no link behind it, which the launch prompt forbids. The other two era-7/era-8 typing cases (Czech/Herrnhut, Anabaptists/Baptists) were weighed and closed in Draft_A; this one was passed on.
